svg.title: FIG 06 · FieldProof
svg.desc: Blueprint of FieldProof, an offline-first field inspection app. Capture: Compose UI and CameraX save inspections, checklist outcomes and photos to Room, the single source of truth, with a durable sync operation per upload carrying a stable idempotency key. Sync state machine: queued, uploading, synced; a transient failure goes back to queued, an exhausted retry budget to failed, and a version conflict to needs resolution. The server is a FastAPI service on PostgreSQL that dedupes by idempotency key and renders PDF reports.
svg.text: works in airplane mode · a retry never makes a second copy of the evidence
177 android tests (jvm + instrumented) · 95 backend tests · ci emulator lane · signed release pipeline
